svg.title: How often the right skill is chosen
svg.desc: 97 tasks SFP had never seen. None were used to tune it. Higher is better. Counts a task as right when the chosen skills include one a person marked correct. The two "+" rows use models on your own machine. Full method: bench/RESULTS.md

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
